subject: Removing alternative alleles not found in parent samples

messages.author: f5cb6d626f60e415
messages.subject: Removing alternative alleles not found in parent samples
parts:
In my sample set I have the parents of the population and I want to ensure that the alternative alleles called are found in at least one of the two parents. So I want to delete markers that are homozygous reference for both parents. What would be the most efficient way to do this?

Thank you!
Rachel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Removing alternative alleles not found in parent samples
parts:
I’m not sure I understand the context, as in R/qtl1, the genotypes have to be coded like A/H/B where one parent has the A allele and the other parent has the B allele.

But you could pull out the genotypes as a matrix with pull.geno, find the columns where the two parents have matching genotypes, and then use drop.markers to omit those markers.

karl
